description: Lists the event types/definitions known to the NetBox system (wraps NBAPI ListEvents). RESOLVEPARTITIONNAMES defaults to true — on by default, the same inverted opt-out default used by this codebase's other fixed-cost enrichments: each returned event is enriched with a PARTITIONNAME field resolved from its PARTITIONID via one GetPartitions fetch per call, not per event (GetPartitions costs the same whether it resolves one event or a thousand). Set RESOLVEPARTITIONNAMES: false to skip it.

RESOLVEPARTITIONNAMES.description: Optional (default true — on by default; an opt-out, not opt-in, default). Enriches each returned event with PARTITIONNAME resolved from its PARTITIONID via one GetPartitions fetch per call (not per event). Set to false to skip it and get the plain ListEvents response.

name: list_events
